# CMA group of companies

> Multi-disciplinary engineering consultancy delivering civil, structural, and mechanical engineering services — from architectural floor plans and 5D walkthroughs to structural FEA and production-ready CAD/CFD.

CMA group of companies is led by Asadullah Anis. We bring civil, structural, and mechanical engineering under one roof to serve developers, contractors, manufacturers, R&D teams, and product startups worldwide.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of all three divisions, projects, pricing, and contact.
- [CAD Projects](/cad-projects): Mechanical CAD modeling, SolidWorks assemblies, and drawings.
- [Analysis Projects](/analysis-projects): FEA stress analysis, CFD flow simulation, and thermal studies.

## Divisions

### Civil & Architectural
- 2D & 3D architectural floor plans
- Photorealistic 3D rendering & visualization
- 5D walkthroughs & virtual site tours
- Site planning & land development layouts
- BOQ, quantity take-off & cost estimation

### Structural Engineering
- RCC & steel structure design
- Foundation & footing design
- Structural FEA (ETABS, SAP2000, ANSYS)
- Seismic & wind load analysis
- Retrofitting & rehabilitation studies

### Mechanical Engineering
- CAD modeling (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Inventor)
- Product design & DFM/DFA optimization
- ANSYS structural & thermal FEA
- CFD — fluid flow, heat transfer, HVAC
- Manufacturing drawings (PDF/DXF/STEP)
